name: Atal'ai Tablet Fragment
summary: The Atal'ai Tablet Fragment is a troll souvenir Rhapsody Shindigger found near a sunken temple. Brohann Caskbelly values it as an Atal'ai artifact.

sections.title: A Troll Souvenir
sections.body: Rhapsody Shindigger found the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment after falling into the water near a sunken temple. He says creepy trolls surrounded him there, and he swam away with this fragment. He gives it to you for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.

faq.q: What is the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment?
faq.answer: It is a troll keepsake that Rhapsody Shindigger picked up near a sunken temple.
Rhapsody says he found the fragment in the water near a sunken temple, surrounded by trolls.

faq.q: Who should I give the fragment to?
faq.answer: Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
Brohann recognizes the fragment as an Atal'ai artifact and calls it quite a find.
